products.name: Party Readiness Board
products.product: A focused family entertainment center party readiness workflow that makes ownership, evidence, exceptions, and the next action visible.
products.audience: independent trampoline parks, indoor play centers, and multi-attraction venues
products.problem: Guest count, package choices, food, attractions, host assignment, waivers, deposits, and special requests change after booking.
products.valueProposition: Turns family entertainment center party readiness into a visible operating queue so every party starts with a current package, space, host, food, attraction, and payment plan.
products.monetization: $19-$99/month based on active records, locations, or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets family entertainment center party readiness software, family entertainment center party readiness tracker, family entertainment center party readiness template, and family entertainment center party readiness checklist searches.
